verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no OpenCode feature for selecting many items (files, sessions, issues) and applying one operation to all of them at once. The closest items are adjacent rather than direct: running multiple agents in parallel, the non-interactive `opencode run` command, and the SDK/server that a developer could script loops against. These are building blocks or a different capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
